about.title: About elxea
about.subtitle: Single-origin leaves from small tea gardens across Japan. What we have decided, and what we have deliberately left open.
about.statementTitle: From small tea gardens across Japan.
about.statementLead1: elxea is a craft tea brand built on single-origin leaves, selected one garden at a time from small growers across Japan.
about.statementLead2: This page sets out, in order, what we have decided and what we have left open.

us.title: About us
us.body1: elxea is a craft tea brand built on single-origin leaves from small growers across Japan. We work with three kinds of tea: green, oolong and black.
us.body2: Every product comes from one garden, one cultivar and one harvest. So the same name can taste a little different from year to year. We do not treat that as a flaw.

subscriptionLp.title: Single Origin Tea Subscription
subscriptionLp.description: Discover the world through tea -- a curated single origin tea subscription.
subscriptionLp.heroHeading:
Discover the world through tea,
a curated single origin tea subscription.
subscriptionLp.brandHeading: elxea is a single origin tea brand delivering premium teas to your doorstep.
subscriptionLp.brandBody: Inspired by the diversity and romance of tea, elxea travels the world to source exceptional tea leaves. Our curated selection of single origin teas lets you experience the terroir of each region, turning your tea time into something truly special.
subscriptionLp.originHeading: The unique charm of single origin tea.
subscriptionLp.originBody1: Single origin means the tea comes from a specific farm, producer, variety, or processing method -- each one creating a distinct identity.
subscriptionLp.originBody2: Unlike mass-produced teas that blend leaves from broad regions for consistent, large-scale supply, single origin teas are often crafted by smaller tea farmers in limited quantities. This is precisely what makes them so special -- each cup offers a distinctive character you won't find anywhere else.
subscriptionLp.originBody3: Like terroir in the world of wine, each tea carries the fingerprint of its soil, climate, and the culture of the people who nurture it. Every cup is a journey -- a once-in-a-lifetime encounter.
subscriptionLp.lineupHeading: Over 40 carefully selected single origin teas from across Japan.
subscriptionLp.planHeading: Discover the joy of great tea, delivered to your door.
subscriptionLp.planNote: * From the 2nd delivery: ¥2,280 per shipment (free shipping).
subscriptionLp.planBenefit1: Over 40 carefully selected single origin teas to choose from.
subscriptionLp.planBenefit2: A bimonthly online journal to deepen your tea knowledge.
subscriptionLp.planBenefit3: Flexible delivery frequency to match your pace.
subscriptionLp.teabagHeading: No teaware needed. Enjoy craft tea anytime, effortlessly.
subscriptionLp.teabagBody: Our tea bags are made from Soilon, a plant-based fiber derived from corn starch, chosen for its minimal environmental and health impact.
subscriptionLp.teabagNote: * Soilon is a plant-based material that fully biodegrades and returns to the earth after disposal.
subscriptionLp.feature1Title: Over 40 carefully selected single origin teas.
subscriptionLp.feature1Body: Choose from over 40 single origin teas sourced from across Japan. Select from three categories: green tea, oolong tea, and black tea.
subscriptionLp.feature1Note: * Available categories may vary by season.
subscriptionLp.feature2Title: A bimonthly online journal to deepen your tea knowledge.
subscriptionLp.feature2Body: Learn about each farmer's production process, regional varieties, and brewing techniques through our bimonthly online journal.
subscriptionLp.feature2Note: * Journal content may change without notice.
subscriptionLp.feature3Body: Skip months you don't need, or change your delivery schedule anytime during your subscription.
subscriptionLp.perk1Body: Enjoy member pricing for events covering global tea culture, wellness, tea picking experiences, food pairing, and more. Meet diverse tea enthusiasts and special guests.
subscriptionLp.perk1Note: * Event themes are subject to change.
subscriptionLp.perk2Body: Purchase individual packs and value packs of your favorite teas at a special 10% discount.
subscriptionLp.disclaimerLine1: * This is a recurring subscription plan.
subscriptionLp.disclaimerLine2: * First-time buyers receive their selected tea set at the special price of ¥1,880 (tax incl.).
subscriptionLp.disclaimerLine3: * Shipping is always free for this plan.
subscriptionLp.disclaimerLine4: * From the 2nd delivery, you can switch to a different tea category. If no changes are made, we'll send our seasonal recommendation.
subscriptionLp.disclaimerLine5: * No cancellation fees or penalties for skipping deliveries.
subscriptionLp.faqA1: Yes, you can cancel anytime. There are no cancellation fees.
subscriptionLp.faqA2: Orders are dispatched within 5 business days.
subscriptionLp.faqA3: We ship via Yamato Transport (Nekopos or Takkyubin).
subscriptionLp.faqQ4: When am I charged for the first order?
subscriptionLp.faqA4: Payment is processed when your order is confirmed.
subscriptionLp.faqA5: The next payment is charged 30 days after your first delivery.
subscriptionLp.faqA6: Subscriptions can be paid by credit card only (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB).
subscriptionLp.faqQ7: Can I return or exchange items?
subscriptionLp.faqA7: Due to the nature of the product, we cannot accept returns or exchanges for customer convenience. Please contact us if you receive a defective item.
subscriptionLp.faqQ8: Can I make a one-time purchase instead?
subscriptionLp.faqA8: Yes, individual products are available on our product pages.
subscriptionLp.faqQ9: What is the shelf life of the tea?
subscriptionLp.faqA9: Approximately one year from the date of production.
subscriptionLp.faqQ10: Can I brew the tea right away? Do I need any special equipment?
subscriptionLp.faqA10: Our teas come in tea bags, so all you need is a cup and hot water.

productDetail.tasteMapLead: 図の見方 — 横軸: 味（すっきり ↔ 濃厚）／ 縦軸: 香り（穏やか ↔ 華やか）。点線は淹れ方で動く範囲。
productDetail.tasteMapNote: 位置は「淹れ方で動く範囲」の目安です。点数ではありません。どこが良いかは決めていません。
productDetail.tastePoint2: 蒸した栗のような甘み
productDetail.tasteLegend1Body: 低温・長めに出すほど厚くなる
productDetail.tasteLegend2Body: 湯温を上げると立ち上がる
productDetail.tasteLegend3Body: 淹れたての立ち香がいちばん強い
productDetail.tasting1Body: 青い草と、蒸した栗。湯気に鼻を近づけたときにいちばん濃く出ます。
productDetail.tasting2Body: 旨みが厚く、渋みはほとんど立ちません。温度を下げるほど甘みが残ります。
productDetail.tasting3Body: 渋みが輪郭をつくり、味が引き締まります。どちらが良いかは決めていません。
productDetail.brew1Body: 小さじ山盛り1杯ほど。急須に入れます。
productDetail.brew2Body: 沸かした湯を一度うつわに移すと、だいたいこのくらいになります。
productDetail.brew3Body: 急須をゆらさずに待ちます。最後の一滴まで注ぎ切ります。
productDetail.brewNote: 数値は目安です。温度・時間を変えれば味も変わります。好きな一杯は、手元で探してください。
productDetail.specSheet7Value: 密閉・冷暗所／開封後1か月
productDetail.chapterTitle: その日の湯温が、その日の味になる。
productDetail.chapterBody: 同じ茶葉でも、同じ味には二度ならない。それを不便と呼ぶか、面白いと呼ぶかは、飲む人にゆだねています。
productDetail.fieldTitle: 霧が、葉をやわらかくする
productDetail.fieldBody: 知覧は朝霧の多い土地です。霧が日射をやわらげるあいだ、葉は渋みを溜めこまずに育ちます。摘採は年に四度ありますが、この茶葉は一番茶だけを使っています。
productDetail.faqQ1: 開封後はどのくらいもちますか
productDetail.faqA1: 密閉して冷暗所なら1か月が目安です。冷蔵庫に入れる場合は、出したあと常温に戻してから開けてください。
productDetail.faqA2: 浅蒸しは葉の形が残り、水色が澄みます。深蒸しに比べて渋みが出にくく、香りが立ちやすい傾向があります。
productDetail.faqQ3: どの茶器が合いますか
productDetail.faqA3: 特に決めていません。急須でも、蓋碗でも、耐熱グラスでも構いません。抽出時間だけ合わせてください。
productDetail.faqA4: この茶葉単体の定期便はありません。季節ごとの詰め合わせは定期便のページをご覧ください。
productDetail.note1: — ご注文から5営業日以内に発送します
productDetail.note2: — 開封後は密閉して冷暗所へ。1か月を目安に
productDetail.note3: — のし・ギフト包装は承っていません

subscriptionR2.voice1Body: 同じ畑でも、摘む日が3日ちがえば別の茶になります。その差を隠さずに送りたいと思っています。
subscriptionR2.voice2Title: 知覧・浅蒸し 川畑
subscriptionR2.voice2Body: 霧が晴れるまで摘まない。待った分だけ、湯を下げたときの甘みが出ます。
subscriptionR2.voice3Title: 川根・中蒸し 大石
subscriptionR2.voice3Body: 渋みは悪者ではありません。食事のあとに飲むなら、むしろ輪郭があるほうがいい。
subscriptionR2.faqQ1: 解約・スキップはできますか
subscriptionR2.faqA1: 次回のご請求日の前日までに、マイページから停止・スキップができます。この期限を過ぎたお手続きは、その次の回から反映されます。回数の縛りはありません。
subscriptionR2.faqA2: クレジットカード（Visa、Mastercard、American Express、JCB）のみご利用いただけます。初回はご注文の確定時、2回目以降はお申し込み日を起点とした応当日に、ご登録のカードへ自動で請求します。
subscriptionR2.faqQ3: 配送はどうなりますか
subscriptionR2.faqA3: ポスト投函でお届けします。送料は月額に含まれます。日時指定は承っていません。
subscriptionR2.faqA4: 3種おまかせのほか、浅蒸し・釜炒り・焙じなど好みの指定ができます。中身は発送前にお知らせします。
subscriptionR2.faqA5: お届け先を分けて登録できます。栞と生産者の便りは毎月同封します。
